summary: [Jobber] objects: Jobber GraphQL: Clients (phones[] free-form, emails[]), Properties (service addresses), Jobs (title, jobType ONE_OFF, lineItems {name, quantity, unitCost}, total, client linkage), Visits (startAt/endAt, title, assignedUserIds, completion), Invoices (status PAID/SENT), Payments (amount, paymentDate), Quotes, Users, Products/Services catalog.
